description: An issue: a proposed future experiment, measurement, or investigation that addresses a gap in evidence for a claim — the graph's todo object, and the middle of the canonical loop: a claim derived from prior claims (tech.scios.rrgi.derivedFrom) is born visibly untested; an open issue requests the test; the evidence produced by running it then supports or opposes the claim. DECISION 2026-07-18 (rebuild W1, user-confirmed): issue stays RRGI's own type, MAPPED TO — not replaced by — the MIRA community schema's Request (github.com/MIRA-science/schema, mira.yaml: Request carries request_for → Study and request_target → Claim). The mapping: MIRA's request_target corresponds to a motivatedBy entry pointing at a claim; request_for (a planned study) is deliberately not adopted yet — our issue points at the GAP, not at a planned study; and our lifecycle — the motivatedBy ARRAY, assignee, status, and the cross-author issueClaim volunteering flow — is RRGI extension with no MIRA counterpart, intended to be proposed upstream to MIRA. Historical lineage, kept as attribution: first ported (2026-05) from the DiscourseGraphs coalition's atproto lexicon (github.com/DiscourseGraphs/schemas, org.discoursegraphs.issue), fields verbatim EXCEPT motivatedBy — an ARRAY of at-uri where the coalition's is singular, so one issue can address several gaps at once. issue is a node; motivatedBy stays a bare at-uri (NOT dual-addressed), per RRGI's decision to dual-address only relation endpoints. Readers normalize string | string[] on read (a legacy single-target record stays valid in the index — the AppView never re-validates already-stored records — and still renders); new writes always emit an array.

text.description: Description of the proposed experiment, measurement, or investigation.

motivatedBy.description: AT-URIs of the claim(s) or evidence gap(s) that motivate this issue. An array — an issue may address several gaps at once. Bare at-uris (issue is a node, not a reified relation endpoint). Readers normalize a legacy single at-uri to a one-element list.

assignee.description: DID of the person who has claimed this issue for investigation.

description.description: Detailed description of the proposed experiment, including anticipated methods, expected outcomes, or decision criteria.
